title: Peuseumahan nyang Meuubah Takdir .
intro: Bak masa awai manusia, sidroe jiwa geubri hadiah deungon niet nyang suci. Bah pih meunan, iri hati meu-ulang-ulang lam bayangan teurimong. Teumeung kisah tokoh nyoe nyang taqwa dan akhe jih tragis geuabadikan lam wahyu ilahi.
clues: Lon na lam kawan generasi phon that manusia.
Ulôn peuseumah keureubeuen ubak TUHAN ulôn, dan keureubeuen nyan geuteurimong deungon jroh.
Keureubeuen syedara ulôn jitulak, dan iri até jih ka jeuet keuseupôt.

Ulôn peugah ubak jihnyan, 'Meunyoe Droeneueh neusunyueng jaroe u ateueh ulôn keu neujak poh ulôn, ulôn hana lôn reuntang jaroe ulôn keu lôn poh maté Droeneueh; beutôi ulôn teumakôt keu Allah, Tuhan alam-alam.'
Lon jeut keu korban buet poh mate nyang phon di ateuh bumoe.
Darah ulôn meu-ulang-ulang, dan ulôn nakeuh syuhada phôn njang hana meusalah.

trial.label: Sidang/Acara
options: Peuseumahan gobnyan geuteurimong, sampoe syedara gobnyan iri dan jipoh maté gobnyan .
Gobnyan jitiek lam tungku nyang teungoh meuapui-apui teuma jiteubiet hana luka .
Gobnyan geupeugot saboh kapai nyang rayeuk that dimiyub bimbingan ilahi .
Jihnyan jiteubiet lé eungkot raya dan teutab lam seupôt .
Gobnyan geupimpén umat Geuh rot laôt nyang teuplah .
trial.answer: Peuseumahan gobnyan geuteurimong, sampoe syedara gobnyan iri dan jipoh maté gobnyan .

location.label: Unsur Kunci
options: Saboh keureubeuen nyang geuteurimong .
Saboh tungkat meuubah jeuet keu uleue .
Saboh unta inong seubagoe tanda ilahi .
Saboh hoopoe jiba haba .
Saboh aneuk leumo méuh nyang geuseumah .

outcome.label: Hasee
options: Peumunuhan phon lam seudjarah; syedara jih teuhuköm
Diteulan bumoe meusajan ngon hareuta jih .
Meuubah jeut keu monyet gara-gara pelanggaran .
Hanco le angen nyang teuga dan es .
Leumoh lam ie raya sibagoe hukoman .
outcome.answer: Peumunuhan phon lam seudjarah; syedara jih teuhuköm

arabic: ۞ وَٱتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ ٱبْنَىْ ءَادَمَ بِٱلْحَقِّ إِذْ قَرَّبَا قُرْبَانًۭا فَتُقُبِّلَ مِنْ أَحَدِهِمَا وَلَمْ يُتَقَبَّلْ مِنَ ٱلْـَٔاخَرِ قَالَ لَأَقْتُلَنَّكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنَّمَا يَتَقَبَّلُ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
verse: And recite to them the story of Adam's two sons, in truth, when they both made an offering [to Allāh], and it was accepted from one of them but was not accepted from the other. Said [the latter], "I will surely kill you." Said [the former], "Indeed, Allāh only accepts from the righteous [who fear Him]. (5:27)
